en: Pair with a six-digit code shown on the other Mac, like Apple devices; each pair of Macs gets a key of its own, listed in Settings › Paired Macs.
Right-click a window to quit its app, open apps with one click, a calmer Windows view, and a menu bar panel in the style of macOS's Wi‑Fi panel.
zh-Hans: 像 Apple 设备一样，用另一台 Mac 上显示的六位数配对码配对；每对 Mac 都有自己的密钥，可在“设置 › 已配对的 Mac”中查看和移除。
右键点按窗口即可退出它的 App，单击即可打开 App，“窗口”页面不再乱跳，菜单栏面板也改成了 macOS 无线局域网面板的样式。
